notes.title: Major update is here!

tags.bug: - correct display of symbols during mini-games;
- the button to close the journal no longer covers the text;
- items crucial for the story appear in the inventory;
- the stamina bar is animated during the cooldown;
- after depletion of stamina, running is possible after regaining half of the value;
- the display of lights in many places has been improved;
- gas station light colliders do not cause collisions in the crouch;
- after collecting the cherry blanket, it doesn't disappear from the locker;
- post-processing effects fixed on several maps;
- the fence on the Berryessa Gas Station map does not disappear when leaving the map;
- fixed animation of mannequins in attics;
- the speaker icon in the Journal Diary returns to its original state after the end of the audio playback;

tags.balance_change: - Zodiac has a better chance to spot you from a very close range;
- improved level design of key puzzles makes the Zodiac not so frustrating in many places;
- Zodiac sees worse in the dark and hears in a shorter distance;
- increasing the distance of displaying POI icons for important objects;
- limiting the presence and activity of the Zodiac in several places;

tags.feature: - added a note with a phone number on Berryessa Gas Station map;

notes.title: HELIBORNE: ENHANCED EDITION AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

[i]Heliborne[/i] is one of the most successful Klabater's releases. Initially released in 2017, it remains one of the publisher’s flagships. Today we would love to let you know that the game just debuted in its ultimate shape!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/b679693ecfa085b455b2ba8cff0639dc9f29d810.jpg[/img]

[i]Heliborne[/i], the Ultimate Helicopter Warfare Experience, is now taken to new heights as the game officially becomes [b][i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i][/b]! The game’s definitive edition brings not only tons of improvement and new content but also debuts at a new price (29,99 USD/EUR) for both the game and all DLCs included! 

--> Heliborne: Enhanced Edition [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433530/Heliborne/]Steam Card[/url]
--> WATCH HELIBORNE ENHANCED EDITION[url=https://youtu.be/28X5Dn9Zw-0] TRAILER[/url]

From now on there is only one ‘Enhanced’ edition of the game containing the base game with all the DLCs released until now (over a dozen!) in the price of the regular game! [b]Klabater decided that all the gamers who already paid for the original edition will now receive Enhanced Edition and ALL DLCs for free[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/67427e0114be9e46650b7dd2044510f40ded0839.jpg[/img]

[i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i] is the next big step for the franchise, meant as a final version of the [i]Heliborne[/i] game dedicated to those who love the game already but also for newcomers. It’s a brand new visual quality mixed with significant gameplay overhaul. The development team is now working on the console edition of Enhanced Edition, and more info will be revealed soon!

With [i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i], the Ultimate PC Helicopter Warfare Experience is now taken to new heights! 
[list]
[*] New Prototype Machines 
[*] Fully Upgraded Game Engine 
[*] New Day & Night Maps 
[*] Updated in-game Physics 
[*] Empowered Multiplayer Experience 
[*] Refreshed User Interface
[/list]
[b]As we promised to our community, all who have bought the game before will get the free update to Enhanced Edition! This is our way of saying thank you’ to all the community that helped us and supported us for years. So, even if you own the basic version of the game with no DLC installed, you will still get access to both the Enhanced Edition of the game and ALL DLCs released until now! Enjoy![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/8df5edc6ebc48de7fbfd170c2c503e9d1c54e615.jpg[/img]
[b]WHAT’S IN IT FOR THE PLAYERS?[/b]

With Heliborne: Enhanced Edition players get the basic game and over a dozen of cool DLC at a very, very reasonable price. A summary of a player’s ‘savings’ below:
[list]
[*] The previous Heliborne price was 19,99 USD/EUR, and DLCs were altogether worth   54,85 USD/EUR... So, until now, the whole package cost 75 USD/EUR.
[*] From August 20, the 75 USD/EUR value content will be priced at 29,99 USD/EUR... As simple as that! You get EVERYTHING at once, and [b]you SAVE 60%[/b]! 
[/list]
KLABATER TEAM

notes.title: This Is The Zodiac Speaking LIVE STREAM
notes.content:
Come and try to find the clues about the serial killer with us during the live stream of [i][b]"This Is The Zodiac Speaking"[/b][/i]! Join us on Wednesday 17th at 13:00 CEST!

[i][b]This is the Zodiac Speaking[/b][/i] is a dark, fact-based single-player FPP adventure thriller combining stealth & detective modes in a stylized world of California 1970s and based on the story of Zodiac, one of the most famous never-caught serial killers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35219373/649bd589c557c85a4d3fc5af666d03742bbe6b09.gif[/img]


Play as Robert Hartnell, a San Francisco journalist, who receives a phone call from the Zodiac greeting him with the memorable "Hello, this is the Zodiac speaking".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35219373/a927ff224dfa1de4bb7b4a735a05c2f6b5f5da7d.gif[/img]


[i][b]This is the Zodiac Speaking[/b][/i] is a thriller with elements of horror, stealth mechanics, detective mode and several endings to discover. The gloomy atmosphere of the game is achieved with the original, stylized graphics and film-like music. The co-author of the script to [i][b]This is the Zodiac Speaking[/b][/i] is Łukasz Orbitowski, one of the best Polish writers, laureate of the prestigious Paszporty Polityki award and nominated for the Nike award.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35219373/7b68c29298662cd81c980fb50a2f34d07bbc711f.gif[/img]


[b]Key Features[/b]

[list]
   [*] Discover the evidence-based story of America's most famous never caught serial killer
   [*] Experience the story from the perspective of a person who survived the attack of the psycho killer
   [*] Unravel the details of the murders during psychological sessions and in detective mode
   [*] Listen to the voices of victims and save their souls
   [*] Discover the alternative endings
   [*] Enjoy the atmospheric, film music
   [*] Travel to the vintage '70s and feel the climate of the past
[/list]
